discussion_comments.comment_body: Update: I initially localized this via next-intl, but reverted it in dde6ae1a. The repo's locale-parity tests (`i18n-vi-completeness`, `i18n-pt-br`) require new keys to exist across all 42 locale files; the two en-only keys broke them, and `i18n:sync-ui` pulls in ~1,579 pre-existing drifted keys per locale, which is well out of scope for this provider PR. Keeping the callout inline so the diff stays focused; proper i18n for this string is better as a dedicated follow-up.

Thanks for the review!

I placed this test beside the component it covers to match the existing convention for dashboard tests in this repo:

- `vitest.config.ts` explicitly includes `src/app/**/dashboard/providers/**/__tests__/**/*.test.tsx` in its `include` globs, so co-located dashboard component tests are intentionally discovered and run by the Vitest UI suite.
- There are already 5 co-located tests in this same `__tests__/` directory — e.g. `ProviderDetailPageClient.test.tsx`, `useModelVisibilityHandlers.test.tsx`, `phase1e.test.tsx`, `phase1f.test.tsx`, `passthroughTestHelpers.test.tsx` — and ~30 co-located `*.test.tsx`/`*.test.ts` files under `src/` overall.

Moving this one under `tests/` would make it the only provider-component test that isn't co-located, breaking that established pattern (and it would need its relative `../components/ProviderModelsSection` import rewritten). For what it's worth, the `.gemini/styleguide.md` referenced here doesn't currently resolve in the repository.

Happy to relocate it if a maintainer would prefer — just let me know.
